sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン — ながながブログ (2006-06-14)
sources.notes: Directly inspected contemporaneous Japanese first-hand ending guide. Covers linear/no-choice structure; first-clear unlocking both hidden endings; the optional 破壊ロボ vs デモンベイン・ブラッド win for West END with combat tips; and final-battle 必滅奥義 input for TRUE END. Applies to the original May 2006 PC game.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン クリア — シバッチの世間話 (2006-06-11)
sources.notes: Independent contemporaneous Japanese first-hand play report with specific first-clear and TRUE END instructions, final-boss tactics, and tested rebinding 上=S, 下=D, 攻=A followed by SDSA. Direct article text available via search inspection; later direct open timed out. This component supports normal/true ending steps, not West END.

sources.title: 機神咆吼デモンベイン — スーパーロボット大戦UX攻略＆まとめwiki
sources.notes: Independent Japanese reference specifically describes the 機神飛翔 sequel's normally unwinnable Doctor West battle and ending caused by winning it. It is not a choice guide for the separate 機神咆吼 predecessor. Combined with B's contemporaneous battle/ending sources to verify West END.
